title: The Jam Jug
lines: Tim has a job. Tim gets jam.
The jam is in a big jug.
Tim can jog. Tim jogs a lot.
The jug tips! Jam is on Tim.
Jam is on his cap. Tim is sad.
Dad gets a rag. Dad rubs it.
Tim gets a bun. Dad gets jam.
Tim did a jig. Dad did a jig.

questions.ask: What happened while Tim was jogging?
questions.listenFor: The jug tipped and the jam went all over him. It is right there in the story. If they only say "jam," ask "and where did it go?"

questions.ask: What did Dad use to clean up?
questions.listenFor: A rag. One word is a fine answer. Have them find the line and read it back so they can prove it.

questions.ask: Do you think Tim had a good day or a bad day? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. You are listening for a reason from the story - the spilled jam, or the bun and the jig at the end. The reason is the whole point.
